description: Real portal-venous contrast-enhanced abdominal CT used as a DICOM decoding, source-review, and non-synthetic overlay gate. It is not arterial-phase CTA and is not vascular ground truth.

source.citation: Roth H, Farag A, Turkbey EB, Lu L, Liu J, Summers RM. Data From Pancreas-CT (Version 2). The Cancer Imaging Archive, 2016.
source.phase: portal-venous, approximately 70 seconds after intravenous contrast

download.dicomContentFingerprintAlgorithm: SHA-256 of the newline-delimited, lexicographically filename-sorted per-file SHA-256 hex digests

proposalOverlay.anatomicalExpectation: A single compact threshold component immediately anterior to the vertebral body in the mid-abdomen; this is a regression landmark, not a validated vessel label.
